channel.title: WolfBoy blog
channel.description: Real privacy fines and settlements, each followed from the official documents to the code behind it and the fix.

item.title: A 301 instead of a 302 made Loomio mark new sign-ups as Gravatar users
item.description: Loomio asked Gravatar about every new sign-up over plain HTTP and read anything but a 302 as yes. Gravatar now answers 301. How I found it, and the 3.12.0 fix.

item.title: Why ClickQuickNow was fined PLN 201,559.50: its 'withdraw consent' link withdrew nothing
item.description: The unsubscribe page of ClickQuickNow, a Polish e-mail marketer, announced a withdrawal that never happened, and empty withdrawal e-mails were ignored.

item.title: Why Arp-Hansen was fined DKK 1,000,000: customer data kept past its own deletion deadlines
item.description: A Danish court fined hotel chain Arp-Hansen DKK 1,000,000; the authority found data kept past the chain's deletion deadlines. What that looks like in Django.

item.title: Why Premom was fined $100,000: analytics events that disclosed health data, as alleged
item.description: Premom's maker agreed to a $100,000 civil penalty after the FTC alleged that event names the fertility app sent to Google and AppsFlyer revealed users' health.
